race.description: Sale Cup October 25th Now On Sale Mdn Plate
race.comment: WOLVES' DEN (8) looks the clear horse to beat following a key scratching. He's placed in his past two, a distant third to a good one at Cranbourne before a close up effort at Geelong out to this trip. Peaks now and finds an ideal race. LADY PUISSANCE (14) steps up in trip. She was fair at Pakenham Synthetic last time out but had been close up at Seymour prior and this should suit nicely. BOLSHIE (3) is a 25 start maiden who is going okay, good to the line at Pakenham last time out when fourth. He can figure with a bit more fitness. HAKUSAN (12) was solid first up at Pakenham Synthetic and gets Shinn on now, expecting improvement up in trip.
